scenes.headline: How Cua Spaces puts any agent on any computer
scenes.sub: A desktop per task, on machines you own.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bowsprit! Cua Spaces gives an agent its own desktop on a computer you own.

scenes.text: Every computer runs one daemon, cua-spacesd, and any agent reaches it through one SDK, directly or through a relay.
scenes.say: The idea: every computer runs one small daemon, and any agent reaches it through the same SDK.

scenes.title: From your agent to a desktop

steps.say: Your agent, say Claude Code, calls the cua SDK.
The Space's id picks the path: an address and a token, or the relay.
Inside the computer, one daemon answers: shell, files, screenshots, windows and video.
It never moves the mouse itself. Input goes through cua driver, linked right in.

scenes.title: Starting an agent inside a Space
scenes.say: To start an agent in a Space, the SDK does four things.

items.say: Install the harness, pinned and checked.
Write the run as files in the guest, so any client can pick it up.
Drive the harness over the agent client protocol.
And give it the Space's own tools.

left.title: HTTPS path
left.say: On the relay's web path, encryption ends at the relay, so it can read the session.

right.title: Mesh path, the default
items: Direct when the ends can meet
right.say: The default mesh encrypts end to end. The relay only forwards ciphertext.

scenes.credit: Author's run, not an official image
scenes.title: A scripted run, no model

steps.say: I ran the daemon on a virtual desktop and drove it from a script: type, then press save.
Reading the window again showed exactly the change.

scenes.title: A foreground click, median
scenes.note: Most of a click is the driver waiting for new windows.
scenes.say: Every click took over a second, mostly the driver watching for a dialog. Cut that watch and the click halves.

scenes.title: One job on three Spaces
scenes.say: Each Space is its own connection, so jobs on all of them overlap almost completely.

scenes.text: Cua stopped owning the agent: one daemon per computer, and whichever agent you already use drives it.
scenes.say: The takeaway: Cua stopped owning the agent. Whichever agent you already use drives the computer.
One daemon per computer. Any agent. And a click is mostly waiting.
